description:

The AMPS team is driven by the mission to provide the best partner experience worldwide. Data Engineering is a horizontal layer that supports all foundational data needs for the organization.

As a Data Engineer on the AMPS team, you will work directly with Software Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Science, and Product teams to continuously improve and build our data infrastructure, data models, tools, and data pipelines. Your work will directly influence organizational insights, customer-facing features, and machine learning models.

Key job responsibilities

- Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources, creating coherent logical data models that drive physical design

description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS — we build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 150 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at massive scale — processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team. This individual will own 3-5 data domains end-to-end, operate hundreds of pipelines, and drive architectural improvements that impact how AWS leadership makes decisions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to design data contracts, build ingestion flows, and deliver analytical models that serve the entire organization.

The ideal candidate is a technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, takes a long-term architectural view, and consistently delivers exemplary solutions. You are an expert with SQL, ETL, and data processing, with experience leveraging cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lambda. The candidate should have hands-on experience with AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, and a strong understanding of designing and building Agentic Frameworks — including autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integration. You are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, able to think big while paying careful attention to detail, and passionate about building data platforms using AI to accelerate the next generation of analytics at AWS scale.

Key job responsibilities
Identify limitations and opportunities in data processing tools, drive improvements and innovation, define data processing guidelines, and ensure best practices in all pipelines designed and reviewed. For example: redesigning ingestion frameworks to handle new AWS service telemetry data, or building reusable transformation patterns adopted across multiple teams.

Define and own data architecture at the team level — ensuring architecture effectively matches business problems and data challenges with security, scalability, and cost effectiveness. Show good judgment making technical trade-offs between short-term technology needs and long-term business needs.

Produce exemplary code — solutions that are easily usable by customers, inventive, secure, easily maintainable, appropriately scalable, and extensible. Build solutions that are easy for others to contribute to. Work to simplify, optimize, and remove bottlenecks.

Define and own infrastructure architecture at the team level. Anticipate data management and access patterns, evolve the technology stack to remove bottlenecks, and deliver systems that are secure, scalable, and long lasting. Define team-level guidelines and best practices for infrastructure management and automation.

Solve complex ambiguous problems — for example, designing cross-domain data models that unify billing, usage, and service telemetry data, or combining multiple datasets to solve problems that couldn't be solved before. Spot areas that might lead to customer confusion, data misinterpretation, or gaps in data contracts.

Effectively split project work into parallel tasks that can be performed by themselves and others and reassembled successfully. Drive to completion projects with dependencies on peers or other teams.

Influence related teams' data architecture and software design. Provide technical assessments for promotions. Actively mentor and develop others. Build consensus when confronted with discordant views.

Drive data engineering best practices — Data Discovery, Naming Conventions, Operational Excellence, Data Security. Ensure team's data is auditable, available, and accessible.

Proactively fix data architecture deficiencies and propose larger projects which may require the work of other teams. Drive improvements through code review, design discussions, team planning, and operational reviews.

Participate in on-call rotation and own operational health of data systems — establish monitoring, alarming, runbooks, and SLA tracking. Drive continuous improvement in reliability and incident response.

description:
Are you passionate about building data infrastructure that powers real business processes and impacts investments at scale?
We're looking for an experienced AI-Driven Data Engineer to design, build, and scale the data foundations — grounded in business context — that power Large Language Models (LLMs), analytics, and autonomous agentic workflows.
In this role, you'll bridge the gap by collecting data from multiple sources and building high-quality pipelines that convert business processes into context, establishing a reusable data model. You'll set up appropriate quality controls and monitor and optimize pipeline throughput to deliver highly available, scalable data pipelines.
You'll work across the full data lifecycle — from ingestion and transformation to modeling and delivery — partnering with software engineers to ensure the right business entities flow through our systems and are translated into data that scientists, BI engineers, and analysts can use for in-depth analysis and metric development.
Beyond solving complex data challenges, this role offers the opportunity to own significant portions of our data architecture, drive improvements to data quality and governance, and directly influence how your team and its customers make data-driven decisions. You'll be at the center of realizing the impact of your work — delivering on the goals of the Global Data Center Capacity Delivery Team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and data infrastructure, applying strong SQL and AWS tools like Glue, S3, Spark , Athena etc to extract, transform, and load data at scale.

- AI/RAG Data Architecture: Build and optimize data models, vector schemas, and feature stores designed for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and analytical workloads.
- Data Quality & Observability: Implement automated data validation, freshness/anomaly monitoring, lineage tracking, and alerting tailored for downstream AI consumption.
- Optimize data storage and query performance through partitioning, indexing, and resource-efficient design across databases and distributed systems.
- Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and engineering peers to gather requirements, prioritize work, and deliver curated datasets and self-service data products that provide clear business value.
- Improve data processes by automating manual operations, implementing data quality and lineage tracking, and contributing to code reviews, design discussions, and engineering best practices.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health and data quality metrics, then shift into building or refining data models that support your team's analytical needs. You might pair with a data scientist to design a data pipeline AI workflow, create and lead a design review to evaluate a new pipeline architecture, or mentor a teammate on data modeling best practices. You will regularly evaluate opportunities to leverage generative AI tools to augment your productivity and streamline repetitive tasks and pipelines

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering reliable, well-governed, data infrastructure that enables informed decision-making across the organization. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a commitment to making data accessible and trustworthy for our customers. As we look ahead, we are investing in modern data practices and scalable solutions that will grow with Global AWS evolving needs. If you are excited about building data systems that matter and growing your career alongside a supportive, inclusive team, we would love to hear from you.

description:

Your pipelines and datasets will let these teams deeply understand customer challenges, rapidly develop tailored solutions, and orchestrate delivery, directly accelerating how AWS delivers business outcomes to our customers.

You will build and operate the pipelines and datasets that feed the context layer and agentic workflows: ingesting external insights, internal data, and insights collected by sales and delivery teams, and turning them into reliable, well-modeled datasets that models and agents can reason over. You design data models, ETL, and integration services that are flexible, extensible, and scalable, then support and grow them over time. This is a hands-on role where the playbook is written in real time. You ship to production and own the correctness of the data that downstream agents depend on.

You are comfortable with ambiguity and partner with business leaders to build the pipelines that answer their key questions. You will unify fragmented data pipelines, build robust data models, and ensure reliable data lineage across multiple product areas, working closely with software engineers, product managers, and analytics teams. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and high opportunity for impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of data pipelines: design, build, test, deploy, and operate
- Build and optimize ETL/ELT jobs that produce the foundational datasets powering the team's products and agentic workflows
- Model structured and unstructured data (external insights, internal data, sales and delivery insights) so it is queryable and consumable by AI agents at scale
- Design the data structures, schemas, and contracts that downstream services and agents depend on
- Build and own data-quality tooling: validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring so bad data does not reach agents or models
- Ship to production regularly in a high-ambiguity environment, balancing speed against reliability
- Raise operational-excellence hygiene (data tests, monitoring, runbooks) for the pipelines you own
- Write clear data models, pipeline design notes, and runbooks a peer can act on

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
